tools.name: list_couriers
tools.description: Find a courier: its key, the credential fields it needs and what it supports (create, track, rates, stop desks, label, cancel). Pass q to search by name.

tools.name: list_wilayas
tools.description: The 58 wilayas couriers deliver to, in French and Arabic. Pass all=true for the 69 of the 2026 division, each with the code to ship it under.

tools.name: list_communes
tools.description: Communes in the spelling couriers accept. Pass wilaya, q or both: the full list is too large to return.

tools.name: create_parcel
tools.description: Create a cash-on-delivery parcel on the merchant's courier account. The "sandbox" courier needs no credentials and creates nothing. Ask the user before creating a real parcel.

tools.name: track_parcel
tools.description: Status and event history of one parcel, in the same status vocabulary for every courier.

tools.name: get_rates
tools.description: Delivery and return fees for a route with one courier.

tools.name: list_stop_desks
tools.description: The stop desks a courier runs in one wilaya. Send a desk id as order.stopDeskId.

tools.name: cancel_parcel
tools.description: Cancel a parcel before the courier collects it. Few couriers offer it: list_couriers says which. Ask the user first.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "create_parcel" references sensitive artifacts (credentials). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "track_parcel" appears informational but accepts parameters (credentials) that enable code/file/secret access.
